protocol_encode_decode_roundtrip: encode a protocol message to JSON bytes and decode it back to verify roundtrip integrity
protocol_validate_request: validate an incoming request message checking for required fields, valid type, and correct token
registry_add_remove_list_nodes: add a node to the file-backed registry, list all registered nodes, or remove one by name
registry_resolve_auto_pick: resolve a node entry by name or auto-pick the single registered node when no name is given
server_handle_request_dispatch: handle an incoming WebSocket request by validating the token and dispatching to the correct handler
